entries.title: Proverbs 8:1
segments: ¶Is not wisdom crying out, and the voice of knowledge sounding?

entries.title: Proverbs 8:2
segments: At the top of the highways, at the meeting of the roads, she takes her place;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:3
segments: Where the roads go into the town her cry goes out, at the doorways her voice is loud:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:4
segments: I am crying out to you, O men; my voice comes to the sons of men.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:5
segments: Become expert in reason, O you simple ones; you foolish ones, take training to heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:6
segments: Give ear, for my words are true, and my lips are open to give out what is upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:7
segments: For good faith goes out of my mouth, and false lips are disgusting to me.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:8
segments: All the words of my mouth are righteousness; there is nothing false or twisted in them.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:9
segments: They are all true to him whose mind is awake, and straightforward to those who get knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:10
segments: Take my teaching, and not silver; get knowledge in place of the best gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:11
segments: For wisdom is better than jewels, and all things which may be desired are nothing in comparison with her.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:12
segments: ¶I, wisdom, have made wise behaviour my near relation; I am seen to be the special friend of wise purposes.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:13
segments: The fear of the Lord is seen in hating evil: pride, a high opinion of oneself, the evil way, and the false tongue, are unpleasing to me.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:14
segments: Wise design and good sense are mine; reason and strength are mine.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:15
segments: Through me kings have their power, and rulers give right decisions.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:16
segments: Through me chiefs have authority, and the noble ones are judging in righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:17
segments: Those who have given me their love are loved by me, and those who make search for me with care will get me.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:18
segments: Wealth and honour are in my hands, even wealth without equal and righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:19
segments: My fruit is better than gold, even than the best gold; and my increase is more to be desired than silver.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:20
segments: I go in the road of righteousness, in the way of right judging:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:21
segments: So that I may give my lovers wealth for their heritage, making their store-houses full.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:22
segments: ¶The Lord made me as the start of his way, the first of his works in the past.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:23
segments: From eternal days I was given my place, from the birth of time, before the earth was.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:24
segments: When there was no deep I was given birth, when there were no fountains flowing with water.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:25
segments: Before the mountains were put in their places, before the hills was my birth:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:26
segments: When he had not made the earth or the fields or the dust of the world.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:27
segments: When he made ready the heavens I was there: when he put an arch over the face of the deep:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:28
segments: When he made strong the skies overhead: when the fountains of the deep were fixed:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:29
segments: When he put a limit to the sea, so that the waters might not go against his word: when he put in position the bases of the earth:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:30
segments: Then I was by his side, as a master workman: and I was his delight from day to day, playing before him at all times;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:31
segments: Playing in his earth; and my delight was with the sons of men.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:32
segments: ¶Give ear to me then, my sons: for happy are those who keep my ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:33
segments: Take my teaching and be wise; do not let it go.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:34
segments: Happy is the man who gives ear to me, watching at my doors day by day, keeping his place by the pillars of my house.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:35
segments: For whoever gets me gets life, and grace from the Lord will come to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:36
segments: But he who does evil to me, does wrong to his soul: all my haters are in love with death.
